source:
[[{{w|II.}}]]

Once, the Earthling stared at a garden snail and asked, "Is consciousness real, or merely an illusion?"

Eta smiled in patience. "Imagine an autumn breeze unlatching an acorn from its branch and casting it into a river. Does the acorn fall to the left or right bank?"

The Earthling frowned. "If it landed in the river, then the answer is neither, or rather, the answer is in between."

Eta let a moment pass before continuing. "Take care not to erect prisons out of your words, Earthling, lest you confine yourself from enlightenment's reach."
translation:
[[{{w|II.}}]]

有一次，地球人盯着一只花园蜗牛，问道：“意识是真实
的，还是仅
仅一种幻觉？”
伊塔 耐心地微笑。“想象一阵秋风从枝头解下一颗橡子，
将它抛入河中。橡子落向左岸，还是右岸？”地球人皱眉。
“如果它落进河里，那答案就是两者都不是，或者更确切
地说，答案在两者之间。”
伊塔 等了一会儿才继续。“小心别用你的言语筑起监牢，
地球人，以免你把自己囚禁在启悟触及不到的地方。”

source:
[[{{w|III.}}]]

The Earthling held a ptychosaur bone in their hand and mused, "What poor creatures! They roamed their planet in sovereignty for millions of years, yet now only through their dusty skeletons do they remain."

Eta responded. "The ptychosaur might speak with the same pity of Earthlings, who have prospered for but a tenth as long as its people had, and who wrongly imagine themselves above the fields of ruin."
translation:
[[{{w|III.}}]]

地球人手握一根褶蜥骨，沉思道：“多可怜的生物！它们
曾以主权姿态漫游自己的行星数百万年，如今却只通过满
是尘土的骨骼残存。”

伊塔 回答：“褶蜥或许也会以同样的怜悯谈论地球人；
地球人的繁荣只有其族人的十分之一长，却错误地想象自
己高于废墟之野。”

source:
[[{{w|IV.}}]]
      
The Earthling put down a hoary tome and asked, "Why-across the clustered cosmos and despite their venerable ages-have no civilizations of the Coven attained consummate knowledge, or reached final enlightenment?

Eta smiled in patience. "I sometimes forget that your people know not of the Mu Door."

The Earthling was intrigued. "What is this door you speak of?"

Eta answered, "The Mu Door is the threshold beyond which a civilization ceases its quest for erudition, having lost the motivation to make further inquiries. It's natural to assume the Door lies at the end of the path of knowledge, but, in fact, the Door is reached far sooner.
translation:
[[{{w|IV.}}]]
      
地球人放下一本古老大部头，问道：“为什么，在群聚宇
宙中，尽管
秘会文明如此古老，却没有任何秘会文明获得圆满知识，
或抵达最终启悟？”
伊塔 耐心地微笑。“我有时会忘记，你们一族并不知道
缪 门。”地球人来了兴趣。“你说的这扇门是什么？”
伊塔 回答：“缪 门是一道阈限；越过它之后，一个文
明便停止追
寻博学，因为它失去了继续提问的动机。人们自然会以为
这扇门位于知识之路的尽头，但事实上，抵达那扇门要早
得多。”

source:
[[{{w|VI.}}]]

After reading the history of Iota Draconis on a light sculpture, the Earthling exclaimed, "Curious! Each Hypatian bears a glassy protrusion from its left clavicle. What is its function?"

Eta paused and then answered thusly, "The nearest meaning in your language is 'friend'."
translation:
[[{{w|VI.}}]]

在一座光雕上读完 约塔 天龙 的历史后，
地球人惊呼：“真奇妙！每个 希帕蒂亚 的左锁骨
上都长着玻璃状突起。它有什么功能？”
伊塔 停顿片刻，随后如此回答：“在你的语言中，最接
近的含义是‘朋友’。”

source: Barathrumites::You were perfect in every iteration.
translation: Barathrumites::你的每一次迭代都完美无缺。
,hate,质疑他们等级制度的正当性

source: Templar,hate,serving as a counterexample to the tenets of their orthodoxy
translation: Templar,hate,作为他们正统教义原则的反例

source: Barathrumites::You saw the fate before you and held it close. We had not your sight; please forgive us. We love you so.
translation: Barathrumites::你看见了面前的命运，并将它紧拥。我们没有你的视界；请原谅我们。我们如此爱你。

source: Barathrumites::As you bathe in Her light and ask your many questions, dearest friend, commit to your memory the replies you receive, that you may tell me of them when I rejoin you.
translation: Barathrumites::当你沐浴在她的光中、提出你诸多问题时，最亲爱的朋友，请把你收到的回答铭记在心，好在我与你重逢时讲给我听。

source: Barathrumites::Today we are bereft of a passionate artisan and dedicated scientist. We laud you, from home to heptagon.
translation: Barathrumites::今日我们失去了一位热忱工匠和献身科学家。我们赞颂你，从家园直到七角。

source: Barathrumites::Phial-mother, font of solutions, your merry bubbling will be so dearly missed.
translation: Barathrumites::药瓶之母，溶液之泉，我们会如此深切地怀念你欢快的冒泡声。

source: Barathrumites::Our choretime philosopher, you are mourned and celebrated. May this be the dreamless rest of which you spoke with such longing.
translation: Barathrumites::我们的杂务时光哲学家，你被哀悼，也被颂扬。愿这就是你曾如此渴望谈起的无梦安息。

source: Barathrumites::Never without a message, you were heard too rarely. What we gleaned of your brilliance will be cherished down generations.
translation: Barathrumites::你从不缺少讯息，却太少被听见。我们从你的辉光中拾得之物，将被后世珍爱。

source: Barathrumites::We miss you, bright kin. Wherever stories are told, we will know you are there with bells on.
translation: Barathrumites::我们想念你，明亮的亲族。凡有故事被讲述之处，我们都会知道你带着铃在那里。

source: Barathrumites::I mourn my dear friend. Aloysius, should you persist in pale blue to flicker through the thin world... tell me so. I eagerly await you.
translation: Barathrumites::我哀悼我亲爱的朋友。阿洛伊修斯，若你仍以苍蓝之色闪烁穿过薄薄世界……请告诉我。我热切等待你。

source: Here lies the metallic husk of a defunct waydroid. It's been stripped of its valuables: copper wire, LED lights, and chrome bearings. It beeps and whirs no longer.
translation: 这里躺着一台停摆路行机器人的金属空壳。它的贵重物已被剥走：铜线、LED 灯和铬轴承。它再也不会哔鸣与呼呼作响。

source:
Your skills represent the abilities you have learned in your
life. Each skill tree has several skills associated with it. You begin with
several skills determined by your caste or calling. You may purchase other
skills by spending skill points which you earn when you gain a level (the
higher your intelligence score, the more skill points you earn).

To purchase a new skill, you must first purchase the entry skill in its
skill tree. You must meet any attribute or power requirements of the skill
you are trying to purchase. It is possible to begin with certain skills 
without having its entry skill if your caste or calling has granted it to
you.

Skills often grant you activated abilities. Once you purchase a skill, you
may access your new activated ability from the Manage Abilities menu ('~CmdAbilities').
translation:
你的技能代表你一生中学会的能力。每个技能树都有若干相关技能。
你开局拥有若干由种姓或使命决定的技能。你可以花费升级时获得的
技能点购买其他技能（智力越高，获得的技能点越多）。

要购买新技能，你必须先购买其技能树中的入门技能。
你还必须满足想要购买的技能所需的属性或能力要求。
如果你的种姓或使命授予了某些技能，你也可能在没有入门技能的情况下
开局拥有它们。

技能通常会授予你已激活能力。购买技能后，你可以在管理能力菜单
（'~CmdAbilities'）中使用新的已激活能力。

source:
Mutations are special biological powers gifted to the denizens of Qud --
true kin from the outer arcologies do not possess mutations. There are two
types of mutations: physical and mental. Each mutation has a mutation score
associated with it. The scores of your physical mutations and the cooldowns
of activated abilities granted by your physical mutations are static. On
the other hand, the scores of your mental mutations are modified by your
Ego modifier and the cooldowns of abilities granted by your mental
mutations are modulated by 5% for each point of Willpower you possess above
or below 16.

Most characters begin with mutation scores of 1. You earn a mutation point
when you gain a new level which you may spend to augment the score of one
of your mutations by 1. The mutation score of none of your mutations may
exceed 1 plus your character level divided by 2. Additionally, mutations
may only be augmented by mutation points up to a maximum score of 10,
though your mental mutations may exceed this score if your Ego further
augments them beyond 10.

Alternatively, you may spend 4 mutation points to choose a new mutation
from three randomly selected mutations. The mutation you choose begins
with a score of 1. If you are a chimera, you are offered a choice of
physical mutations, if you are an esper, you are offered mental mutations,
otherwise you are offered three completely random mutations. Mutations
often grant you activated abilities. Once you gain a mutation, you may
access your new activated ability from the Manage Abilities menu ('~CmdAbilities').

Defects are mutations with primarily negative effects. Certain mutants
begin with a single defect. There is no score associated with defects.
translation:
突变是 库德 居民获赐的特殊生物能力，来自外层穹城的真民没有突变。
突变分为两类：物理突变和精神突变。每个突变都有对应的突变等级。
你的物理突变等级，以及物理突变授予的已激活能力冷却时间，都是固定的。
另一方面，你的精神突变等级会受自我调整值影响；
精神突变授予的能力冷却时间，则会按你的意志力高于或低于 16 的每一点
调整 5%。

大多数角色开局的突变等级为 1。你每次升级都会获得一个突变点，
可花费它使你的一个突变等级提高 1。你的任意突变等级都不能超过
1 加上角色等级除以 2。此外，突变最多只能通过突变点提高到 10 级；
不过，如果你的自我继续将精神突变强化到 10 以上，精神突变可以超过此数值。

或者，你可以花费 4 点突变点，从三个随机选出的突变中选择一个新突变。
你选择的突变初始等级为 1。如果你是嵌合体，可选项会是物理突变；
如果你是心灵术士，可选项会是精神突变；否则会提供三个完全随机的突变。
突变通常会授予你已激活能力。获得突变后，你可以在管理能力菜单
（'~CmdAbilities'）中使用新的已激活能力。

缺陷是主要带来负面效果的突变。某些变异者开局会有一个缺陷。
缺陷没有对应等级。

source:
[[{{C|Weapons}}]]
Every weapon has a penetration value and a damage value
(for example, {{C|→}}4, {{R|♥}}1d4). The penetration value of melee weapons is related
to your strength score, though the value is capped based on the material of
the weapon ('l'ook at a weapon to view its penetration cap). Missile weapons
have static penetration values that do not change based on your strength score.
Weapons may modify other statistics; 'l'ook at a weapon to fully determine
what it does.

[[{{C|Armor}}]]
Most pieces of armor have an armor value and a dodge value
(for example, {{b|♦}}4 {{K|○}}4) that augment your own {{b|♦}}AV and {{K|○}}DV (see {{g|Attributes}}).
Pieces of armor may modify other statistics; 'l'ook at a piece of armor to
fully determine what it does.
translation:
[[{{C|武器}}]]
每件武器都有穿透值和伤害值
（例如 {{C|→}}4、{{R|♥}}1d4）。近战武器的穿透值与你的力量值有关，
但会根据武器材质设有上限（'l'ook 查看武器可看到其穿透上限）。
投射武器的穿透值固定，不会随你的力量值变化。
武器还可能调整其他属性；'l'ook 查看武器即可完整了解其作用。

[[{{C|护甲}}]]
大多数护甲都有护甲值和闪避值
（例如 {{b|♦}}4 {{K|○}}4），会提高你的 {{b|♦}}护甲 和 {{K|○}}闪避（见 {{g|属性}}）。
护甲还可能调整其他属性；'l'ook 查看一件护甲即可完整了解其作用。

source:
[[{{C|Melee Combat}}]]
Melee combat is combat between two adjacent opponents with standard melee
weapons such as swords, daggers, axes, and clubs. To attack a hostile
adjacent opponent, simply move in the direction of the opponent. To attack
something else, such as a non-hostile opponent or a wall, use '~CmdAttackDirection'
and select the direction in which you wish to attack.

When you make a melee attack against a target, the following sequence of
events occurs:

[[{{c|1. Determine whether or not you hit the target.}}]]
Your to-hit roll is 1d20 plus your agility modifier plus any bonuses you
receive from your weapon or skill powers. If this roll exceeds your
opponent's dodge value (DV), then you hit. An empty circle icon over your
target indicates that your attack missed.

[[{{c|2. Determine whether a shield block takes place.}}]]
If the target has a shield equipped, they have a base 25% chance to block
with it, increasing with skill. A successful block adds the shield's armor
value (AV) to the target's AV for this attack.

[[{{c|3. Determine how severely your attack penetrates your target's armor.}}]]
Each weapon has a penetration value ({{C|→}}4, for example). This value
represents the armor value (AV) that your weapon will usually penetrate
with ease. If your weapon's penetration value far exceeds your target's AV,
your weapon will likely penetrate several times. Each time your weapon
penetrates your target's armor, your target is dealt damage equal to your
weapon's damage value ({{R|♥}}1d4, for example). A filled circle icon over your
target indicates that your attack hit but failed to penetrate your target's
armor. A heart icon indicates that your attack hit and penetrated your
target's armor.

[[{{c|4. Determine if multiple attacks are made.}}]]
There is a 15% chance that you make an additional attack with your
secondary hand. Characters with multiple limbs may make additional attacks
beyond this.

[[{{C|Missile Combat}}]]
Missile combat is combat between two opponents with missile weapons such
as bows, pistols, and rifles. To make a missile attack, press '~CmdFire' to aim
your weapon, then '~CmdFire' again to fire.

When you make a missile attack, the following sequence of events occurs:

[[{{c|1. Determine the trajectory of your missile.}}]]
How far a missile is likely to veer from its projected path is determined
by your agility score and the weapon's accuracy.

[[{{c|2. Hit the first medium-sized or larger object along the missile's}}
{{c|trajectory.}}]]

[[{{c|3. Determine how severely the missile penetrates your target's armor.}}]]
This is resolved in the same way as a melee attack.

[[{{c|4. Determine if multiple attacks are made.}}]]
Certain powers allow you to fire multiple missiles with certain missile
weapons.

If you are engaged in melee combat with more than one hostile opponent,
there is a 50% chance that each missile attack you make goes wild (veers
45 degrees to the left or right).
translation:
[[{{C|近战战斗}}]]
近战是两个相邻对手使用剑、匕首、斧、棍棒等标准近战武器进行的战斗。
要攻击相邻的敌对对手，只需朝该对手的方向移动。
要攻击其他目标，例如非敌对对手或墙壁，使用 '~CmdAttackDirection'，
然后选择你想攻击的方向。

当你对目标进行近战攻击时，会按以下顺序结算：

[[{{c|1. 判断你是否命中目标。}}]]
你的命中掷骰为 1d20 加上敏捷调整值，再加上你从武器或技能能力获得的
任何加值。如果此结果超过对手的闪避值（闪避），你就命中。
目标上方的空心圆图标表示你的攻击未命中。

[[{{c|2. 判断是否发生盾牌格挡。}}]]
如果目标装备了盾牌，他们有基础 25% 几率用盾牌格挡，
此几率会随技能提高。成功格挡会在此次攻击中将盾牌的护甲值（护甲）
加入目标的 护甲。

[[{{c|3. 判断你的攻击穿透目标护甲的严重程度。}}]]
每件武器都有穿透值（例如 {{C|→}}4）。此数值代表你的武器通常能够轻松穿透的
护甲值（护甲）。如果你的武器穿透值远高于目标 护甲，
你的武器很可能会多次穿透。每当你的武器穿透目标护甲一次，
目标就会受到等同于武器伤害值的伤害（例如 {{R|♥}}1d4）。
目标上方的实心圆图标表示你的攻击命中，但未能穿透目标护甲。
心形图标表示你的攻击命中并穿透了目标护甲。

[[{{c|4. 判断是否进行多重攻击。}}]]
你有 15% 几率用副手进行一次额外攻击。
拥有多条肢体的角色可能进行更多额外攻击。

[[{{C|远程战斗}}]]
投射战斗是两个对手使用弓、手枪、步枪等投射武器进行的战斗。
要进行投射攻击，按 '~CmdFire' 瞄准武器，再按一次 '~CmdFire' 开火。

当你进行投射攻击时，会按以下顺序结算：

[[{{c|1. 判断投射物的轨迹。}}]]
投射物可能偏离预定路径多远，取决于你的敏捷值和武器精准度。

[[{{c|2. 命中投射物轨迹上第一个中型或更大的物体。}}]]

[[{{c|3. 判断投射物穿透目标护甲的严重程度。}}]]
此步骤与近战攻击相同。

[[{{c|4. 判断是否进行多重攻击。}}]]
某些能力允许你用特定投射武器发射多个投射物。

如果你正与多个敌对对手进行近战，你每次投射攻击都有 50% 几率偏飞
（向左或向右偏转 45 度）。
